title: Honest Voice-Fill (verify before you voice)
description: The autonomous lever when the pipeline is saturated (every sequence frozen at human-gated stage-6 vr_testing) and subtitle truth-beats are exhausted. Fill @identity on scripted-but-voiceless artifacts — but FIRST confirm the 'voiceless' report is real, not a name-resolution false-negative.
triggers: pipeline saturated what to work on
earned_from: breath 2026-07-04T09:00 — primitives voice 75->79; find_gd registry resolver surfaced +157 false-negative voiceless project-wide (54%->60%)

nodes.label: Verify the voiceless report is REAL
nodes.detail: garden_listener.find_gd matches by file STEM. Any artifact whose lookup-name != file-stem (folding_past->animated_folding_past, dgrid->durer_grid) is a FALSE-NEGATIVE 'voiceless'. Resolve lookup-name -> registry scene_path -> .tscn script ext_resource -> .gd before believing 'no @identity'. The resolver now lives in find_gd; NO_GD_FILE after it = genuinely scriptless (e.g. a pure .tscn) = skip, do not fabricate a script.

nodes.label: Pick 3-4 scripted-but-voiceless artifacts
nodes.detail: Cap at ~4/breath (anti-pattern: too-many-maps). Prefer the FOCUS_VECTOR sequence; when its scripted-voiceless set hits ~0, rotate to the next GROWING sequence, then a DORMANT one.

nodes.label: Write grounded @identity (see identity-writing flow)
nodes.detail: 8 fields, each grounded in the actual exports/_ready/_process behaviour + the registry description. Grounding guards sieve-Q3: a generic block is a sterilising seal, not voice. Place the block between the header comment and `extends`.

nodes.label: Measure honestly, not by pipeline avg
nodes.detail: read_identity via the resolver must return truth for each target; scriptless ones stay unresolved (correct). Re-run garden --diagnosis for the voice delta. Do NOT expect pipeline mean-head to move — it is frozen at stage-6 vr_testing (headset-gated) and is dead as a breath signal. Confirm release gates PASS 4/4; commit ONLY the touched files (never git add -A — working-tree drift persists).
